The album that won Album of the Year at the 67th Annual Grammy Awards ceremony was *Cowboy Carter* by Beyoncé.

The release date of the album was **03/29/2024** (E10).

The country that hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics is France (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Summer_Olympics). The capital city of France is Paris.

The current mayor of Paris, as of April 2025, is Emmanuel Grégoire (https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260322-socialist-frontrunner-emmanuel-gr%C3%A9goire-elected-paris-mayor-rachida-dati). He belongs to the Socialist Party.

The party leader of the French Socialist Party is Olivier Faure (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olivier_Faure).
